description: Add an image (JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, AVIF) or a PDF to a Static files project in layernote, as a new file or, with versionOf, as the next version of a file (the same kind of file). Give `url` for one link or `files` for up to 10, for example the exports of designs you just fixed in Figma: layernote fetches them itself. For a file the user has on their computer, give no link: an upload panel opens in the chat and the user drags the file into it. Tell them so; an image pasted in the chat itself can’t be passed on. Only upload when the user asks.

fileName.description: The name to give it. A new version without one keeps its file’s name

files.description: Several links at once, each with its own name and versionOf

project.description: The project, by name or id from list_projects. Only needed when the token reaches several projects

url.description: An https link to the image or PDF, for example an image link from the Figma connector. layernote fetches it

versionOf.description: A file id from list_files: the upload becomes that file’s next version

name: upload_file
title: Upload a file or a new version
